endpoint_sampling_semantics: The material collector labels endpoint frames exact when final T01 time is within 1.1e-6 s of requested end. All paired times are equal between providers; they are not bitwise equal to their requested end-time values.
interpretation: The four native input inventories and engine/starter hashes match exactly. All 85 converted T01 output columns were finite and compared at identical CSV sample times. The principal endpoint displacement, nominal axial stress, internal energy, and external work match exactly at report precision. Other CSV fields contain small numeric differences; the maximum absolute difference across mixed-unit columns is not itself an accuracy metric, and relative differences in near-zero transverse channels are not meaningful without a physical scale. This is a runtime-provider comparison, not physical material validation or solver-admission evidence.
purpose: Compare the entire converted T01 histories and measured coupon endpoints for the four paired 07 controls.

runtime_timing_diagnostic.basis: Recorded process elapsed_s in the native run receipts for these four short coupon engine processes; exploratory only.

study: LAW112 transfer coupon run endpoint-window baseline versus private OpenBLAS runtime controls

summary.full_history_difference_interpretation: Per-field maxima and scales are retained; do not interpret cross-unit aggregate absolute error or near-zero-channel ratios as a single pass threshold.
